label: Machinedrum OS and flash image
description: Machinemodule runs your own Machinedrum UW OS 1.63 file (a free download from Elektron). Your Machinedrum UW flash image (8 MB) is optional: it adds the ROM sample machines and the 16 factory kits.
hint: After adding the OS file, load Machinemodule once and restart MPC: it makes its skin from that file. With a flash image the first load takes about 2 minutes.

rules.label: Machinedrum UW flash image
rules.note: The right size for a Machinedrum UW flash image. The plugin reads it on its first load and makes the ROM samples and factory kits from it.

label: Your kits (optional)
description: Machinedrum kit dumps (.syx). Each file appears as a bank of kits.

rules.label: Kit dump
rules.note: An Elektron SysEx file. Its kits appear if it holds Machinedrum kits.
